hits.about: Grove Ridge by Emaar is a contemporary residential development set within the green heart of Emaar South, Dubai’s emerging golf-centric community. Overlooking the championship 18-hole golf course, the project features a refined collection of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments and limited 3-bedroom townhouses, designed with open-plan layouts and expansive balconies that frame uninterrupted views of lush fairways. Developed by Emaar, Grove Ridge blends modern architecture with nature-inspired interiors, creating homes that feel calm, spacious, and connected to the outdoors.Residents enjoy access to resort-style amenities, landscaped gardens, and wellness-focused facilities, all within a master-planned destination that balances leisure, lifestyle, and long-term value. With its strategic location near Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai, Grove Ridge offers an ideal choice for both end users and investors seeking growth in Dubai South’s future-ready corridor.
hits.title: Grove Ridge

hits.about: The Grove at Sobha Sanctuary is an exclusive low-rise villa enclave by Sobha Realty, set within Dubai’s landmark nature-led master community in Dubailand.Designed as a private residential cluster, The Grove offers expansive 4-, 5-, and 6-bedroom estate villas, surrounded by landscaped parks, shaded pathways, and a calm blue-green network that promotes wellness-driven living.Homes at The Grove are thoughtfully positioned for privacy, with direct access to cycling tracks, pedestrian trails, and open green corridors. The architecture reflects Sobha’s signature craftsmanship, featuring smart-home readiness, private courtyards, large terraces, and select layouts with private pools and lifts.Residents enjoy seamless access to Sobha Sanctuary’s central park, wellness loops, resort-style water features, and lifestyle amenities, creating a refined environment where nature, space, and long-term livability come together effortlessly.
hits.title: The Grove

hits.about: Mangrove Residences is a luxury project by Expo City, located in the eco-friendly neighbourhood of Expo City, dubbed the city of the future. Mangrove Residences offers residents luxury, comfort and beautiful views of nature in one of Dubai's most desirable neighbourhoods.Mangrove Residences is very conveniently located close to the important places of Dubai. Dubai Mall, one of the largest shopping and entertainment centres in the world, is a 30-minute drive away. Dubai Festival City and Ras Al Khor Nature Reserve are just over 30 minutes away.All residences are finished with natural stone and wood. The interior of the flats and townhouses is decorated in light colours, and the windows offer incredible views of Dubai and its attractions.
hits.title: Mangrove Residence

hits.about: Grove On The Park is a project by Nshama, located in the Town Square neighborhood. The complex is a 10-storey building with stylish facades in a modern style and large windows reflecting the sunlight.  The interior decoration uses high quality materials and prevails gentle light shades, which visually expands the space and creates a cozy atmosphere. Each residence has a balcony with stunning views of the park or cityscape. Grove On The Park has a large number of amenities that include a swimming pool, gym, and playgrounds for children. At the foot of the complex is a large Town Square Park with plenty of walking, biking jogging paths, recreational facilities, and barbecue areas. Within walking distance residents can find cafes, restaurants, stores, supermarkets, laundry, pet store, atelier and beauty salon.  The Town Square neighborhood is located in the southwest of Dubai. Its main feature is a lot of green spaces, residential properties are literally buried in greenery, which creates a feeling of maximum proximity to nature. Another feature of the district is its location near the main highways of the city, which provides quick access to the main objects of the city. Dubai Hills Mall and Expo City are just 20 minutes away, while Dubai Mall and Burj Al Arab are about 25 minutes away.
hits.title: Grove On The Park

hits.about: The Grove is a premium residential complex from the developer Iman Developers, which includes studios and apartments with 1-3 bedrooms in its collection. The undoubted advantage of this project is its location in the Dubai Hills area - one of the most environmentally friendly, a significant part of which is made up of parks and gardens. The main transport interchanges are located near the complex, providing quick and easy access to socially important facilities (schools, hospitals) and other places in Dubai:1 kilometer to Dubai Hills Mall;7 kilometers to the Mall of the Emirates;16 kilometers to the Burj Khalifa tower and the artificial island of Palm Jumeirah;26 kilometers to Dubai Expo City;28 kilometers to Dubai International Airport.Residents will enjoy modern amenities, open spaces and natural light - with floor-to-ceiling windows in each apartment offering breathtaking views of the surrounding cityscape.The Grove by Iman is an ideal place to live for any modern person who prefers a calm atmosphere of comfortable country life.
hits.title: The Grove

hits.about: Set in the heart of Dubai Islands, Bay Grove Residences by Nakheel presents a rare opportunity to embrace waterfront living at its finest. This final release of Phase 4 introduces four elegantly designed residential towers, offering a mix of 1 to 4-bedroom apartments and an exclusive 4-bedroom penthouse. With sweeping sea views, vibrant podium gardens, and refined interiors, the project redefines modern luxury by the sea.Crafted for resort-style coastal living, the residences combine privacy with community energy. Residents enjoy direct access to the promenade and premium shared spaces, such as infinity pools, a stylish clubhouse, outdoor fitness areas, and landscaped paths. Developed by Nakheel — one of Dubai’s most visionary developers — Bay Grove Residences reflects architectural sophistication, unbeatable amenities, and attractive pricing, making it a compelling lifestyle and investment choice.
hits.title: Bay Grove Residences

hits.about: Belgrove Residences Meydan by Ellington Properties is the pinnacle of architectural excellence, offering meticulously designed 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments that redefine luxury off-plan living in Meydan Horizon. Inspired by the elegance of flamingos, this development combines beauty, balance, and innovation. Located in a prime spot, Belgrove Residences features breathtaking views of Ras el Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, Downtown, and Creek Skylines. Ellington Belgrove Residences Dubai offers world-class amenities, including a sky lounge, resort-style pool, fitness center, and kids' play areas, ensuring a balanced lifestyle for all ages.This exclusive community provides not only luxury living but also practical convenience. Belgrove Residences' location ensures easy access to Meydan's vibrant surroundings, while its flexible payment plan makes it an attractive investment in one of Dubai's most sought-after areas. Ellington Properties' commitment to quality is evident in every detail, from the high-end finishes to the comprehensive living experience. Belgrove Residences at Meydan truly offers an unparalleled lifestyle, combining the best of urban sophistication and natural beauty
hits.title: Belgrove Residences

hits.about: Binghatti Grove at JVC offers luxury apartments in Jumeirah Village Circle, developed by Binghatti Developers. This off-plan property features 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments designed with biophilic architecture, blending nature and contemporary living. The 42-story tower showcases elegant facades and sustainable materials. On the ground floor of Binghatti Grove, there are 16 retail spaces.Residents can enjoy many amenities, including a serene pool deck, outdoor yoga areas, fitness zones, and sports courts. Binghatti Grove's location provides easy access to crucial routes like Al Khail Road, making it a prime spot for city living. Binghatti Grove in JVC combines luxury with sustainability, offering a unique living experience in Dubai’s thriving community.
hits.title: Binghatti Grove

hits.about: The Highgrove in MBR City by Ellington Properties introduces a new standard of luxury living, offering a variety of residences, including one to three-bedroom apartments, penthouses, duplexes, and sky villas. Nestled in a prime location near Downtown Dubai and the World Islands, it promises connectivity and exclusivity, making it a sought-after destination for modern living.  The project boasts exceptional amenities, including a crystal lagoon with sun loungers, an infinity-edge leisure pool, fitness studios, a clubhouse, children’s indoor and outdoor play areas, and a flotation therapy pool. These thoughtfully designed features create an oasis of relaxation amidst Dubai's vibrant energy.  Ellington’s The Highgrove caters to diverse lifestyles, offering expansive spaces for comfort and elegance. With convenient Highgrove payment plans and proximity to iconic landmarks, the development provides an unmatched opportunity for Mohammed Bin Rashid City property investment. Whether for living or investment, this project offers a lifestyle that is both fulfilling and luxurious in one of Dubai’s most prestigious communities.
hits.title: The Highgrove

hits.about: Grove is a unique luxury residential complex designed by Emaar, one of the most prestigious developers. This amazing project includes four towers, each of which has a unique look, height from 9 to 11 floors and harmoniously fits into the picturesque landscape of Dubai Creek Harbour. The project offers a wide range of apartments, which are characterized by their comfort and functionality. The choice of layouts includes one, two and three bedroom residences with beautiful views of the courtyard and green spaces, as well as luxurious four-bedroom penthouses offering amazing direct views of the canal waterfront.Residents are uniquely positioned to enjoy a variety of benefits and amenities that include a wave pool, an expansive Central Park that is the perfect place to relax and stroll. Equally attractive is the picturesque waterfront, which offers the opportunity to enjoy views of the waterways. There is also a Splash Pad area with water rides and a playground for the little ones and their parents. For adults, there is a lounge area near the bar area.The location of Grove Towers allows residents of the complex to quickly get to the sights of Dubai. In six to seven minutes you can reach Al Khail Road, which provides convenient transportation access. The unique Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is just 15 minutes away, Palm Jumeirah Beach and Dubai Marina are a 20-30 minute drive, and Dubai International Airport is approximately 12 minutes away.
hits.title: Grove

hits.about: Introducing Farm Grove by Emaar Properties at The Valley, an exceptional collection of 4 to 5-bedroom stand-alone, semi-detached, and detached villas. These family homes offer an exquisite combination of luxury and comfort, featuring spacious layouts, expansive windows, and abundant natural light that create a warm and harmonious living environment.Farm Grove Villas provide the perfect balance of privacy and togetherness, making them an ideal choice for those seeking a serene yet connected lifestyle. Residents enjoy easy access to stunning parks and lifestyle amenities, ensuring an enriched living experience. Located within The Valley, a master-planned community by Emaar Properties, Farm Grove is nestled along the Dubai–Al Ain Road.
hits.title: Farm Grove

hits.about: Discover luxurious living at Mangrove Emaar, a new residential enclave situated in the heart of Creek Beach within the prestigious Dubai Creek Harbour (DHC). This exceptional Mangrove Emaar location offers a range of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments available for sale, perfectly positioned next to a serene park. Each residence at Mangrove Emaar is meticulously crafted to enhance the quality of life, with spacious interiors that maximize both comfort and natural light.The modern elegance of the design is complemented by private balconies or terraces that offer panoramic views of the lush parkland, creating a tranquil resort-like atmosphere. Mangrove Creek Beach Residents have access to superior amenities and services, along with an extensive road network that connects them to the vibrant life of Dubai. The community also features 700 meters of immaculate white sands at Creek Beach, a stunning infinity pool, and exceptional sunset views, making Mangrove Emaar DHC an ideal home for a family-friendly retreat.
hits.title: Mangrove Creek Beach

hits.about: Live life to the fullest in a serene place where you can have it all. At Golf Grove Emaar, create wonderful memories with your loved ones; revitalize your mind, soul, and body; and break free from the hustle of daily commute to your workplace.Upscale Lush CommunityLocated along the 18-hole championship golf course set in a family-oriented neighborhood, this upscale spot is slated to be one of the most exclusive communities in the heart of the metropolis with its 3- and 4-bedroom villas ranging from 2930 sq. ft to 3365 sq. ft.It is home to lush green landscapes, parks, rolling fairways, and a suite of luxurious facilities such as the golf course and clubhouse. Add to this a spectrum of dining and retail selections, Golf Grove Dubai sets the benchmark for a high-class community lifestyle in the 21st century.Luxurious Lifestyle in Perfect BalanceFeaturing a suite of amenities that offer a perfect balance of sheer opulence and supreme convenience for an active lifestyle, Golf Grove offers a wealth of impressive opportunities for the entire community. It was conceived to foster well-being and harmony amidst the hustle and bustle of the city.A Bright Future in the Heart of DubaiThe neighbourhood features three schools making Golf Grove Dubai an ideal location to raise a family. With exclusive selections such as Gems International School, world-class education facilities, and pleasant areas for your children to play after school, this community offers a promising opportunity to create a bright future.
hits.title: Emaar Golf Grove

hits.about: Introducing Grove at Creek Beach, Dubai Creek Harbour by Emaar. A stunning collection of 1 to 4 bedroom apartments with fantastic views of the Creek Canal. With the Creek Beach access, Grove is set to redefine a waterfront lifestyle in Dubai’s most idyllic family community. Creek Beach is an integral district within Dubai Creek Harbour. It is close to Ras al Khor wildlife sanctuary and is an ideal place for residents to find a home.
